title: Delete Text (TextAndFormat)

scenarios.title: Delete Text applies its documented behavior
scenarios.expected: Delete Text (BtnDeleteText) is invoked on the documented fixture deck and produces its documented effect on the selection or presentation, leaves no new entry in %TEMP%\oPenEfficiency\error_YYYYMMDD.log and does not leave PowerPoint or the add-in in an unstable state.

scenarios.title: Delete Text empties the text and keeps the shape in real PowerPoint
scenarios.expected: In an isolated real PowerPoint host, the deployed Delete Text on a text box with sample text empties the text range (exact empty read-back) while the shape itself remains on the slide with an unchanged shape count, the feature reports execution, no new entry appears in the oPenEfficiency error log of the run day, and the host stays stable.

snapshotNotice: Source scenario inventory only; ready/planned/blocked are planning states, not passing results. Office runner scripts and maintainer release evidence are not distributed with this source snapshot.
